text:
hana: Quick sync - Prospect (Midland Trust) wants an air-gapped POC. Must-haves: signed bundle + CycloneDX SBOM, HSM verification path, tamper-evident media, and explicit upgrade cadence in SOW. Also asked for no telemetry by default. Who can confirm constraints?

joel: We offer two artifact flavors: full bundle (operator + runtime + model snapshot) and delta minibundles (weights diff + manifest). Typical sizes: full 20-60GB; delta 0.5-6GB.

priya: Lead times: full build+SBOM+sign ~3bd after manifest lock; minibundle ~1bd. Physical courier + chain-of-custody adds ~2-4bd. Expedited shipment is extra.

hana: They want a 30-day upgrade guarantee window and a proposed monthly security delta. Can we commit?

joel: Standard: monthly small security deltas (auto-generated) + quarterly full model packs. For a guaranteed monthly minibundle schedule we need a monthly retainer (ops work: build, sign, verify, courier).

priya: Telemetry off is supported. Caveat: removes remote observability. Support retainer up ~15% to cover manual diagnostics and increased SE time. We should include an offline diagnostics runbook in SOW.

hana: Legal flagged "no-beacon" language in the questionnaire. @legal-bot, any standard clause we can reuse?

legal-bot: Use our standard no-beacon clause. Add: explicit acceptance criteria for 'telemetry disabled' (manifest flag + verification steps) and an offline diagnostics option. Also call out emergency hotfix SLA as optional.

joel: Quick acceptance checklist we can send SecOps (6 bullets):
- Verify sha256 checksum equals manifest
- Verify signature with provided CA cert
- Validate CycloneDX SBOM matches artifact
- Dry-run install on isolated node (no egress)
- Confirm telemetry disabled flag in config and effective
- Run smoke test and rollback validation

priya: Copyable verification commands to include:

sha256sum redwood-bundle-2026.tar.gz
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_pub.pem -signature redwood-bundle.sig redwood-bundle-2026.tar.gz
cyclonedx-cli validate --sbom sbom.json --artifact redwood-bundle-2026.tar.gz
cat manifest.json | jq '.images[] | {name, digest}'

hana: Logistics note: recommend tamper-evident seal + serial-numbered USBs + signed courier manifest. Offer insured shipping for high-value deliveries.

joel: Ops gotcha: signer key rotation requires re-sign of active bundles. If they want customer-managed signing (HSM), we do a verification-only flow or PS-assisted rehearsal. Expect ~20% uplift on packaging fee for HSM work.

priya: Pricing lines to propose:
- One-time packaging + SBOM + signing fee (includes manifest & acceptance checklist)
- Monthly retainer for patch generation, verification, and courier coordination (if monthly cadence requested)
- Emergency hotfix SLA (48h) as optional paid add-on
- HSM/customer-key integration: professional services day-rate

ops-bot: Created ticket POC-MT-1759 and attached internal airgap runbook template. Assigned to joel + priya.

hana: I'll draft SecOps email with checklist + commands + three cadence options: (A) standard monthly deltas + quarterly fulls, (B) monthly minibundles (retainer), (C) quarterly fulls only. Include hotfix SLA and HSM PS pricing. Closing thread once sent. :white_check_mark:
